cases.translation: ‘A sower went out to sow,’ he said.
cases.explain: Сеятель is the subject of the intransitive verb вышел, so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Иисус, выйдя из ___, сидел у озера.
cases.translation: Jesus, having gone out of the house, sat by the lake.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always takes the genitive → дома.

cases.translation: The servants came to the master and said...
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always takes the dative → хозяину.
рассказал (told) is transitive and takes its direct object in the accusative → притчу.

cases.sentence: Царство небесное можно сравнить с горчичным ___.
cases.translation: The Kingdom of Heaven can be compared to a mustard seed.
cases.explain: сравнить с (compare with) uses the preposition с, which takes the instrumental → зерном.

cases.sentence: И он о многом говорил им в ___.
cases.translation: And he spoke to them about many things in parables.
cases.explain: В marking location, not motion, takes the prepositional → притчах (plural).

cases.translation: Some of them fell by the road.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by, next to) takes the genitive → дороги.

cases.sentence: Найдя драгоценную ___, он продает все, что имеет.
cases.translation: Having found a precious pearl, he sells all that he has.
cases.explain: Найдя (having found) is transitive and takes its direct object in the accusative → жемчужину.

reading.ru: В тот же день Иисус, выйдя из дома, сидел у озера.
reading.question: What did Jesus do on that day?
options: He went out of the house and sat by the lake
He went into the temple to teach
reading.correct: He went out of the house and sat by the lake
reading.explain: The text says Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.

reading.ru: Другие упали в каменистые места, где было мало плодородной почвы.
reading.question: Where did some of the seeds fall, according to the parable?
options: On rocky ground with little soil
In a garden with rich soil
reading.correct: On rocky ground with little soil
reading.explain: The text says other seeds fell on rocky places where there was little fertile soil.

reading.ru: Семена же, которые упали на хорошую почву, принесли урожай, одни во сто, другие в шестьдесят, третьи в тридцать раз больше того, что было посеяно.
reading.question: What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?
options: It produced a crop, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times what was sown
reading.correct: It produced a crop, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times what was sown
reading.explain: The text says the seed on good soil produced a crop, a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was sown.

reading.ru: Вам дано знать тайны небесного царства, а им не дано.
reading.question: According to Jesus, who has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven?
reading.explain: Jesus tells the disciples that it has been given to them to know the mysteries of the kingdom, but not to the crowds.

reading.ru: Блаженны ваши глаза, потому что они видят, и ваши уши, потому что они слышат.
reading.question: Why does Jesus call the disciples' eyes and ears blessed?
reading.explain: Jesus blesses their eyes and ears because they see and hear.

reading.question: In Jesus's explanation, what does the seed that fell by the road represent?
options: The word snatched away by the devil before it is understood
A person who bears much fruit
reading.correct: The word snatched away by the devil before it is understood
reading.explain: Jesus explains that the seed by the road is the word the devil snatches from the heart before it is understood.

reading.ru: И вот когда все спали, пришел его враг, посеял среди пшеницы сорняки и ушел.
reading.question: What did the enemy do while everyone was sleeping, in the parable of the wheat and weeds?
options: He sowed weeds among the wheat and left
reading.correct: He sowed weeds among the wheat and left
reading.explain: The text says the enemy came while everyone slept, sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.

reading.ru: Хотя горчичное зерно и самое маленькое из всех семян, но когда оно вырастает, то становится больше огородных растений и превращается в настоящее дерево, так что даже птицы небесные прилетают и вьют гнезда в его ветвях.
reading.question: What happens to the mustard seed once it grows, per the parable?
options: It becomes a tree larger than the garden plants
It stays the smallest of all plants
It is eaten by birds while still small
reading.correct: It becomes a tree larger than the garden plants
reading.explain: Though the mustard seed is the smallest of seeds, it grows into a tree larger than the garden plants.

reading.ru: «Царство небесное, как закваска, которую женщина смешала с тремя мерами муки, чтобы вскисло все тесто».
reading.question: In the parable of the yeast, what does the woman do?
options: She mixes yeast into three measures of flour until it leavens all the dough
She bakes bread for the disciples
She plants yeast in a field
She sells yeast at the market
reading.correct: She mixes yeast into three measures of flour until it leavens all the dough
reading.explain: The parable says a woman mixed yeast into three measures of flour until it worked through all the dough.

reading.question: In Jesus's explanation of the parable of the weeds, who is the enemy that sowed them?
reading.explain: Jesus explains that the enemy who sowed the weeds is the devil.

reading.ru: Царство небесное можно сравнить со спрятанным в поле кладом.
reading.question: What is the Kingdom of Heaven compared to in the parable of the hidden treasure?
options: A net cast into the sea
reading.explain: The parable compares the Kingdom of Heaven to treasure hidden in a field.

reading.ru: Еще царство небесное подобно сети, опущенной в озеро, в которую попало много разной рыбы.
reading.question: What is the Kingdom of Heaven compared to in the parable of the net?
options: A net let down into the lake that caught all kinds of fish
reading.correct: A net let down into the lake that caught all kinds of fish
reading.explain: The parable compares the Kingdom of Heaven to a net let down into the lake that caught fish of every kind.

reading.ru: Не бывает пророк без чести, разве только в городе своем и в своем доме.
reading.question: According to Jesus's saying, where does a prophet lack honor?
options: In his own town and in his own home
reading.correct: In his own town and in his own home
reading.explain: Jesus says a prophet is without honor only in his own town and in his own house.

reading.ru: Он пришел в свой родной город и начал учить людей в синагоге.
reading.question: What did Jesus do when he came to his hometown?
options: He began teaching people in the synagogue
He healed every sick person there
reading.correct: He began teaching people in the synagogue
reading.explain: The text says Jesus came to his hometown and began to teach the people in the synagogue.
